def shp(g,bg):
    seen=set(); res=[]
    for i in range(len(g)):
        for j in range(len(g[0])):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and (i,j) not in seen:
                col=g[i][j]; st=[(i,j)]; seen.add((i,j)); cells=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):

                        if 0<=x<len(g) and 0<=y<len(g[0]) and g[x][y]==col and (x,y) not in seen:
